artifacts.summary: Confirms all three absorbed scopes (opencode spam/frozen-policy/fake-tool-line, picker Reload All/Regenerate honesty, Global Update) are still fully unimplemented, flags that defect-class-2 evidence (lean agent file paths) has drifted stale, and recommends a 3-phase plan split by disjoint file scope.

memory_candidates.content: In lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua, validate_opencode_fragment() sorts agent_name keys before iterating (table.insert + table.sort) specifically to make its accumulated error list deterministic across repeated runs, since Lua's pairs() iteration order is otherwise nondeterministic for string keys. Worth reusing this sort-before-iterate pattern anywhere else in the codebase that builds a reported list from a pairs()-iterated table and needs run-to-run determinism.

.opencode/ in this repo is an independently git-tracked, hand-maintained tree (its own commit history, e.g. 'mirror to .opencode/' commits) that is NOT a deploy artifact of the .claude-extensions.json source-store system -- .claude-extensions.json has no entry or source_dir pointing at it. The source-store/deploy-boundary rule (edit the source store, never hand-author the deployed .claude/** tree) therefore does not apply to .opencode/**; it can be edited directly.
